name: Bacardi Cocktail
instructions: Shake the rum, lime juice and grenadine hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Angel Face
instructions: Stir all three with ice until cold. Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Blood and Sand
instructions: Shake everything with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange peel.

name: Bronx
instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Champagne Cocktail
instructions: Put the sugar cube in a flute and soak it with the bitters. Add the cognac if using, then slowly top with chilled champagne. Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Brandy Crusta
instructions: Rim a small wine glass with sugar and line it with a long strip of lemon peel. Shake the rest with ice and strain into the glass.

name: Sloe Gin Fizz
instructions: Shake the sloe gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice. Strain into a chilled highball glass without ice and top with soda water.

name: Negroni Sbagliato
instructions: Pour the Campari and vermouth into an ice-filled rocks glass and stir briefly. Top with prosecco and garnish with an orange slice.

name: Mezcal Negroni
instructions: Stir all three with ice and strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube. Garnish with an orange peel.

name: Porn Star Martini
instructions: Scoop the passion fruit pulp into a shaker, add the vodka, liqueur, lime juice and vanilla syrup and shake hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe, float half a passion fruit on top and serve the prosecco in a shot glass on the side.

name: Japanese Slipper
instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a slice of honeydew melon.

name: Golden Dream
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice and strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Remember the Maine
instructions: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe and discard the excess. Stir the rye, vermouth and Cherry Heering with ice and strain into the glass. Garnish with a cherry.

name: Improved Whiskey Cocktail
instructions: Rinse a rocks glass with absinthe and add a large ice cube. Stir the rest with ice and strain into the glass. Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Fish House Punch
instructions: Shake everything with ice and strain into an ice-filled punch cup or rocks glass. Grate a little nutmeg on top. Scale up and serve over a block of ice for a party.

name: Sherry Cobbler
instructions: Shake the sherry and syrup with the orange slices and ice. Strain into a glass packed with crushed ice and garnish with berries and a mint sprig. Serve with a straw.

name: Brandy Flip
instructions: Shake everything without ice to whip the egg, then shake again with ice. Strain into a small wine glass and grate nutmeg on top.

name: Air Mail
instructions: Shake the rum, lime juice and honey syrup with ice. Strain into a flute and top with champagne.

name: Hugo Spritz
instructions: Gently press the mint in a large wine glass, fill with ice and add the elderflower liqueur. Top with prosecco and soda water, stir once and garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Scorpion
instructions: Shake everything with crushed ice and pour into a tall glass or tiki mug. Garnish with a gardenia or a mint sprig.

name: Navy Grog
instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a double rocks glass over crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Fog Cutter
instructions: Shake everything except the sherry with ice and pour into a tall glass or tiki mug filled with crushed ice. Float the sherry on top.

name: Suffering Bastard
instructions: Shake the gin, brandy, lime juice and bitters with ice. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass and top with ginger beer. Garnish with mint and an orange slice.

name: Three Dots and a Dash
instructions: Shake everything with crushed ice and pour into a tall glass. Garnish with three cherries and a pineapple spear on a pick.

name: Missionary's Downfall
instructions: Blend everything with a cup of crushed ice until smooth. Pour into a coupe or tiki glass and garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Saturn
instructions: Shake everything with crushed ice and pour into a tiki glass or coupe. Garnish with a lemon peel and a cherry.

name: Test Pilot
instructions: Shake everything with crushed ice and pour into a double rocks glass. Garnish with a cherry.

name: Cobra's Fang
instructions: Shake everything with crushed ice and pour into a tall glass or tiki mug. Garnish with a lime wheel and a mint sprig.

name: Dr. Funk
instructions: Shake the rum, lime juice, grenadine and absinthe with ice. Strain into a tall glass filled with crushed ice and top with soda water.

name: Queen's Park Swizzle
instructions: Press the mint lightly in a tall glass, add the rum, lime juice and syrup, and fill with crushed ice. Swizzle until the glass frosts, top with more crushed ice and dash the bitters on top. Garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Chartreuse Swizzle
instructions: Add everything to a tall glass filled with crushed ice and swizzle until cold. Top with more crushed ice and garnish with a mint sprig and grated nutmeg.

name: Blue Hawaiian
instructions: Shake everything with ice and strain into a hurricane glass filled with ice. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

name: Bushwacker
instructions: Blend everything with a cup of ice until smooth. Pour into a hurricane glass and grate nutmeg on top.

name: Batanga
instructions: Salt the rim of a highball glass and fill it with ice. Add the tequila and lime juice, top with cola and stir with a knife.

name: Cantarito
instructions: Salt the rim of a clay cup or tall glass and fill it with ice. Add the tequila, juices and a pinch of salt, top with grapefruit soda and stir.

name: Madras
instructions: Build in an ice-filled highball glass and stir. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Lynchburg Lemonade
instructions: Shake the whiskey, triple sec, lemon juice and syrup with ice. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass, top with lemon-lime soda and garnish with a lemon slice.

name: Cuban Manhattan
instructions: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a cherry.

name: Bourbon Smash
instructions: Muddle the lemon wedges and mint with the syrup in a shaker. Add the bourbon, shake with ice and double strain into a rocks glass over crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Whiskey Smash
instructions: Muddle the lemon and mint with the syrup in a shaker. Add the whiskey, shake with ice and strain into a rocks glass over crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Ranch Water
instructions: Fill a highball glass with ice, add the tequila and lime juice, and top with sparkling mineral water. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Mind Eraser
instructions: Fill a rocks glass with ice. Pour in the coffee liqueur, then layer the vodka on top, then the soda water. Drink quickly through a straw.

name: Earthquake
instructions: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Strong, so sip slowly.
